clearedSpotChecks.check: Parts two and three for SOL-2026-7 (leads L-028, L-151, L-152). Which L or E step of the default sequence acts on the PoolManager build, and does any load it replaces, or any store it removes, rely on an address whose base variable was reassigned?
clearedSpotChecks.note: I compared the files myself. The creation and runtime code in build/PoolManager.json, work/pm.default.json and work/pm.noL12E.json are equal. The noL12E settings hold the default sequence of OptimiserSettings.h:44-63 at v0.8.26 with the E and the first two L removed and the third L kept in CTUca[r]LSs; the cleanup is fDnTOcmuO. So only the third L can shape the output. I diffed work/preL3.fun_swap.yul against work/postL3.fun_swap.yul and read the replaced loads. One load listed as mload(_331) is the fourth load of result, because _331 is add(var_result_4424_mpos, 64) at preL3.fun_swap.yul:939. Between each source and its replaced load (for example preL3.fun_swap.yul:790-798, 807-816, 816-826, 940-948) there are only loads and arithmetic, with no mstore, sstore or call. The only reassignment of var_result_4424_mpos after line 12 is at line 147, which sets it to the same memPtr and leaves at once (matches Pool.sol:320). No replacement relied on a decision that two addresses are different, so the stale bookkeeping cannot have produced a wrong value. I did not repeat the scan of the other 17 functions line by line. I read reassign.py and L3-reassign.json, and they report no memory or storage address built from a reassigned variable in those functions.

clearedSpotChecks.check: Part one. Which entries of the Solidity bug list apply to solc 0.8.26 with the settings of foundry.toml, and what SOL-2026-7 needs according to the primary source.
clearedSpotChecks.note: I fetched bugs_by_version.json and bugs.json from raw.githubusercontent.com again. They list eight bugs for 0.8.26 (released 2024-05-21) with the conditions, introduced and fixed versions the research cites: SOL-2026-7 needs yulOptimizer, affects 0.8.19 to 0.8.37 and is fixed in 0.8.38. SOL-2026-5 and the evmasm variant of SOL-2026-8 have viaIR false. foundry.toml sets via_ir = true, optimizer_runs = 44444444, solc 0.8.26 and cancun. The settings in build/PoolManager.json match. The Solidity post, which now redirects to www.soliditylang.org/blog/2026/10/22/..., states the four conditions as the research quotes them.

clearedSpotChecks.check: Part four. What transient storage, the memory-safe assembly blocks and the user defined value types with operators mean for each listed bug.
clearedSpotChecks.note: The v0.8.26 DataFlowAnalyzer.cpp copy (lines 55-92) gives load and store names only for the dialect's memory and storage functions, and m_analyzeStores handles only simple storage and memory stores. SemanticInformation.cpp:67-78 gives TLOAD and TSTORE their own TransientStorage location, with no memory or storage effect. L3-loadcount.json shows the same tload (63) and tstore (27) counts before and after the active L. The lock, the deltas and the synced reserves therefore stay outside the scope of SOL-2026-7. I also checked the self transfer case in src/ERC6909.sol:24-47. The source reads and writes the sender slot and then the receiver slot, and coincide.json records 0 mismatches in 3000 cases.
